c74object.name: evi_ladder_moog
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Nonlinear 24dB Moog Ladder filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi_ladder_moog is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_ladder_moog.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr, evi_tanh.genexpr, evi_interp.genexpr
evi_ladder_moog is also available in MSP as: evi.ladder.moog~.
A classic nonlinear Moog Ladder emulation. This is the smoothest and most in tune of all the evieve TPT Ladders and handles high resonance very well. It responds particularly well to and remains stable under audio rate modulation, therefore capable of all the classic analog Ladder effects.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: In. Audio input to be filtered.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: in Hz or Pitch @default 81. Cutoff frequency in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..1..2 @default 1. Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with ease, remaining smooth and in tune.

attribute.name: cutoffmode
attribute.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (default on) or Hz (off).

attribute.name: cutoffsmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the cutoff (inlet 2). If audio rate modulating inlet 2 this should be turned off (the default).

attribute.name: nonlin
attribute.description: Unlike unit delay filters, TPT filters allow us to switch out the nonlinearity in the feedback loop without having to retune the filter. 0=tanh-like, 1=polynomial-saturator. Each give the filter slightly different characteristics.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

attribute.name: ressmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the resonance (inlet 3). If audio rate modulating inlet 3 this should be turned off (the default).
